snippet.title: Furniture Assembler Simulator
snippet.description:
In Furniture Assembler Simulator, you assemble furniture for a living.
You start small and poor, with cheap tools, and take on simple orders to pay the rent.
As you go, you build your reputation, skills, and income, unlocking better tools and orders.
